about_the_game:
Experience Liberec like never before — through someone else’s eyes, in real locations, with choices that truly matter.

"Interaktivně o Liberci" is a short interactive first-person film, fully shot on a professional cinema camera. You play as a local welcoming a long-lost visitor to Liberec — and every decision you make shapes how the day unfolds. Where you go, who you meet, and how it all ends… it’s all up to you.

Sometimes you’ll be the perfect guide. Other times, things might go completely sideways. And be warned — some choices might cut the story short entirely.

💡 What to expect:

  • 🎥 Authentic first-person interactive film, shot on a cinema-grade camera

  • 🧭 Every choice reshapes the story — new places, different people, unique endings

  • 😄 Dry humor, unexpected turns, and natural, human dialogue

  • 🕒 2–15 minutes of gameplay, depending on your path

  • 👤 Single-player experience with optional group play at offline events

  • 🏙 Real locations across Liberec — from iconic spots to hidden corners

Perfect for anyone who wants to explore a city differently — with a sense of humor, curiosity, and the understanding that even the smallest decision can change everything.

Your visit to Liberec starts now.

short_description: A first-person interactive film where you decide how the day unfolds during a visit to Liberec with someone you haven’t seen in ages. Choose your path, shape the experience — and be careful. One wrong choice might end everything.
